intro: Matrix Zinc RO Water Purifier is a countertop domestic water purifier designed for brackish water. It features an advanced RO + UF + UV purification system with zinc and copper alkaline enhancement, delivering safe, great-tasting drinking water. Equipped with an 80 GPD membrane, 10-litre storage tank, and 12 LPH purification capacity, it is suitable for homes with water TDS up to 3000 ppm.
features: Advanced RO + UF + UV purification for effective removal of impurities.
Zinc & Copper Alkaline Technology to enrich purified water with essential minerals.
80 GPD Thin Film Composite membrane for efficient filtration.
Purification capacity: Up to 12 litres per hour.
10-litre storage tank for uninterrupted water availability.
Suitable for brackish water with TDS up to 3000 ppm.
Multi-stage filtration: Sediment, Pre-Carbon, Post-Carbon, Zinc, Copper Alkaline, UF, and UV.
Wide voltage operation (100–300V AC) for reliable performance during voltage fluctuations.
Countertop installation with high-quality Merlin pump and components.
